question: Do the complete Held /1 and provisional Figiel /2 declarations reproduce the independent mixed-chloride water observations, and does Figiel improve every primary source/system/ionic-strength bucket?
authority: Engine issue #556 and binding lead resolution comment 6204697972; Stage A accepted at 2aca2f656407c51e37abe0cd314619a92954cc6f by delivered review round 2 (#558). Lead Stage B instruction clarifies the MS-2 extrapolation as composition, not ionic strength.
freeze_rule: Commit this specification, the explicit frozen-realizations.csv, acceptance rules and input hashes before computing any comparison residual. Later outputs record their specification hash and commit. No realization is selected using residuals.

conditions.reference: pure liquid solvent at the same T/P, complete parameter declaration and permittivity model; evaluated permittivity may differ with composition

native_call: Reference.solvent_activity(x=complete_model_order_fractions); Python declares compositions and reads native water activity, osmotic coefficient and diagnostics. No Python thermodynamic subtraction, solver, optimizer or refit.
bucket_membership: Use nominal source-composition ionic strength in mol/kg water, with I=3 included in the lower bucket. Keep the identical observed rows in each bucket for all realizations and both declarations; retain perturbed I and any boundary crossings explicitly.
activity_limit_meaning: Separate water-activity error limits calibrated at one Dinane endpoint; not equivalent coefficient limits throughout the dataset or under RMS transformation. An aw pass implies no Phi pass.
metric_grouping: Each declaration, source, system and ionic-strength bucket; also full range and exact nominal source mixing-fraction labels. Robinson uses its printed particle-fraction labels, Rard its source-column ionic-strength fractions, and Dinane fractions derived from the explicit molalities. Do not pool quantities or source residuals.
absolute_qualification: Every mandatory nominal bucket and every frozen realization must pass both primary limits, with no native failure omitted and Robinson reconstruction sensitivity <=0.001 Phi. A failed or sensitivity-dependent bucket prevents qualification of the declaration. Source-flag omission is additional sensitivity and cannot erase the full-row result.

transfer_test.rule: In every primary bucket and every frozen realization, require RMS_Held-RMS_Figiel > quantity resolution and max_error_Figiel <= max_error_Held+resolution. A tie, reversal, native failure, unavailable result or unresolved numerical ordering means transfer is unproven. This is separate from absolute qualification.

rounding: Half of the last printed decimal place, derived from the original text token, on independent primary inputs only. Structural zeros stay zero. Derived I, q, y, R and salt molalities are recomputed from the perturbed independent inputs; diagnostic printed derived labels are never independently perturbed.
finite_sensitivity_scope: The explicit finite cases are one independent input/group at a time in each direction, shared reference/fraction/stock cases, source-wide joint primary rounding in each direction, Robinson observation alternatives and the source-flag omission. They are conditional finite scenarios, not exhaustive corners of all rounding intervals and not a probabilistic uncertainty interval.

operations.round_input: Add amount to the named printed field in rows matching the exact selector. Robinson m_N/m_Ca, Rard m_T, and Dinane m_N/m_Mg/aw are independent; recompute all source-derived quantities and native composition. A change in observed aw alone does not change the model input.
operations.round_shared_reference: Add amount to the named reference field in all rows matching the selector. Robinson groups by set/subseries; Rard by physical table/row across every fraction cell. For Robinson also shift the Table 2 mean-M_B anchor of that set by amount divided by its number of distinct subseries; retain its nominal printed rounding offset. Reinterpolate from those adjusted anchor coordinates. Mean-M_B is derived and is not an additional independent rounding variable.
operations.round_reference_anchor: Add amount to the selected Robinson Table 2 reference Phi anchor and reinterpolate every affected Table 1 reference.
operations.round_shared_fraction: Move the Rard source-column y by amount for every cell in that table/column, then derive m_N and m_Mg from y and m_T.
operations.joint_primary_rounding: For the selected source, move every independent primary input to its signed half-last-place endpoint. Reference copies and source fraction columns move together. Robinson anchor mean coordinates follow the average of the signed subseries-M_B shifts and reference Phi anchors move by their own half-last-place. No derived quantity or diagnostic ratio is perturbed independently.
operations.observation_alternative: Use the retained Robinson quadratic-reference or printed-R alternative directly. For the combined case use retained printed-R Phi times retained quadratic_reference_phi/linear_reference_phi. These change only the reconstructed observation, with the same native composition.
operations.common_concentration_scale: Multiply both mixture formula-salt molalities and the shared reference molality by 1+amount, retaining reference Phi. Select all rows, one whole table, or all NaCl-reference physical rows with nominal m_ref<=1.2590. Candidate low-reference rows are varied together; do not invent which five equilibrations had the reported 0.12-0.13% uncertainty.
operations.Mg_stock_scale: Multiply mixture MgCl2 molality by 1+amount across the selected complete table(s), with NaCl unchanged. Recompute m_T, y, I and q. Values come from the adopted stock and its two reported analyses and the larger reported analytical uncertainty. Shared whole-source and whole-table scenarios bracket unknown stock assignments; they do not assign independent row errors.
operations.Na_stock_scale: Multiply mixture NaCl and any NaCl reference molality by 1+amount across selected complete table(s); MgCl2 and CaCl2 references stay unchanged. The stated stock-1 analytical values and uncertainty define the finite scenarios. Stock-2 uncertainty and exact stock-to-series assignment are unavailable; these scenarios are not a complete stock uncertainty bound.
operations.Ca_reference_Phi_scale: Multiply reference Phi by 1+amount for every CaCl2-reference row in the selected table(s); NaCl-reference rows stay unchanged. This is a shared reference component, using the reported 0.2% and 0.4% magnitudes.
operations.reference_change_Phi_offset: For the selected Rard table/y series, add amount to mixture Phi only on its CaCl2-reference rows. The common offsets use the largest reported low-Na-fraction 0.003 or high-Na-fraction 0.004 discrepancy; all affected source cells move together.
operations.omit_source_flagged: Omit only the one explicitly source-zero-weight row from this additional sensitivity, retaining it in nominal and every other realization. Never omit a native failure.

uncertainty_reporting: No invented pointwise sigmas, weights, chi-squared confidence or claim of agreement within experimental uncertainty. Rard: show relative Phi residuals and ratios to reported scatter/concentration/reference components without treating them as equivalent errors or independent noise. Dinane: label ratios to reported 0.0006 aw and 0.028 Phi with their unresolved fit/measurement meanings. Robinson: uncertainty remains absent and the reconstruction sensitivity is shown separately.
reference_checks: Keep 16 pure-Ca endpoints, 10 NaCl reference anchors and 4 binary-Mg checks separate from mixture scores. R and Engine-Pitzer differences are diagnostics without a separate limit; no Pitzer recalculation or mixture refit is authorized.
failure_reporting: Retain every row and its native availability cause, pressure closure, density slope, branch and input/specification hashes. Any native failure triggers diagnosis before changing approach; failed rows never disappear into partial statistics.
numerical_resolution: Repeat nominal native predictions on identical inputs; require differences below the quantity comparison resolution. Stage A identities and columns are numerical verification; measured-mixture comparison is physical validation only for the stated quantities and tested domain.
application_limit: MS-2 raw major-ion ionic strength is approximately 6.7 mol/kg on the retained specific-gravity/TDS water-mass proxy. This ionic strength lies inside the measured ranges: Rard-Miller extends to about 9.87 mol/kg and Robinson-Bower to about 8.55 mol/kg. Show the one-liter water basis, formal molalities, charge imbalance and chloride projections from the retained inventory. The extrapolation is in composition: two ternary systems do not qualify a simultaneous Na/Ca/Mg feed. The source temperature differs from 298.15 K and the conditioned inlet is undefined. Individual-ion activities, extraction chemistry, solids, carbonate chemistry, temperature dependence and calorics remain unqualified.
